svg.title: Alpheus, the first idea, as a pencil sketch
svg.desc: A pencil sketch on notebook paper. Four steps, fetch, split, clean and aggregate, stand in a row above the ground, each a box with an agent beside the component, and split drawn three times for three replicas. Dashed arrows between them carry tiny signals such as “chunk 17 ready”. Under the ground runs a river: object storage, with chunk files and a manifest in it. Arrows go from each step down into the river and up from it into the next step. Thought bubbles say: every step runs at the same time; no message broker, only tiny signals, and even those are optional; a chunk is just a file and Alpheus never opens it; crash, outage or restart, pick up at the last ack; one StreamRun is one run: create, watch, delete.

g.text: object storage (S3): the river runs underground
a chunk is just a file.
pick up at the last ack
